# AI Text Watermark Audit

> Local-first tools for observable Unicode signals and sourced AI text watermark claims.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/steven-panxd/ai-text-watermark-audit

## Verified scope

- `textmark scan` reports Unicode format controls, tags, unusual spaces, variation selectors, and narrow mixed-script confusables.
- `textmark compare` describes byte-level and character-level differences between two versions.
- The tool does not make AI-authorship claims.
- The tool does not claim to detect or remove Claude's unpublished statistical watermark.

## Claude status verified 2026-08-14

Anthropic says supported Claude models launched on or after 2026-08-02 embed machine-readable marks in generated text. Third-party detection details have not yet been published.

Primary source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773-how-claude-marks-ai-generated-content
